questions.question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.

He knows that / he has no other option / but to work hard.
questions.solution:
The erroneous part is: **but to work hard**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• 'no other' and 'than' are **correlative conjunctions**.
 
• **Correlative conjunctions** are pairs of words that work together to join two elements of equal importance within a sentence.
 
• In this case, "no other" and "than" are used as a correlative conjunction to express a comparison or contrast between two options.
 
• In the sentence, "no other" is used to emphasize that there are no alternative options available. It suggests that the person referred to in the sentence has exhausted all possibilities and has only one option left.
 
• "Than" is used to introduce the only remaining option, which is to work hard.
 
• The combination of "no other" and "than" acts as a correlative conjunction because they work together to join the elements of the sentence, indicating the limited choices and emphasizing the necessity to work hard.
 
• Hence, 'than' must replace 'but' to make the sentence grammatically correct.

Therefore, the correct answer is: *He knows that he has no other option **than** to work hard.*

questions.question:
Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence.

The blind man said to me, “Can you help me cross the road?”

options.text: The blind man asked me if I could help him cross the road.
The blind man asked me if I will help him cross the road.
The blind man asked me if I could help him crossed the road.
The blind man asked me if I can help him cross the road.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **The Blind man asked me if I could help him cross the road.**** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• As the mode of the sentence is **interrogative, “ask”** is used in the indirect sentence.
 
• In an indirect sentence, “**ask**” is always **followed by “if” or “whether”**
 
• If the **sentence within the quotation is in the form of a question**, it should be **converted into a statement sentence**.
 
• As the **sentence is in the past tense**, the **indirect sentence too will be in past form** and “**can” would be converted into “could**”.
 
• Therefore, the correct indirect sentence will be "**The blind man asked me if I could help him cross the road."**

**​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• Option **two** is incorrect as it is **grammatically incorrect** for consisting of “**will” instead of “could**”.
 
• Option **three** is **incorrect** as it is **grammatically incorrect** for the **subordinate clause containing two main verbs- “help” and “crossed”.**
 
• **Fourth** option is also **grammatically incorrect** as the **subordinate clause is in the present tense**

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

The important points were narrated in the class by the teacher.

options.text: The teacher was narrating important points in the class.
The teacher had narrated the important points in the class.
The teacher narrated the important points in the class.
In the class, the important points were narrated.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **The teacher narrated the important points in the class.**** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

In order to convert a passive sentence into an active one-

__
 
• The **object** should be **brought back to its original object position** from the subject position.
 
• The be verb should be omitted.
 
• The tense will remain the same.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **The teacher narrated the important points in the class.​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 **is **incorrect** as the sentence is in **past continuous **tense while the main sentence is in the past tense.
 
• **Option 2 **is **incorrect** as the sentence is in **past perfect **tense while the main sentence is in the past tense.
 
• **Option two** is **grammatically incorrect** as the past perfect tense is used only **when two works happened simultaneously inthe past tense;** the work that happened earlier is of past perfect tense while the **other is converted into past tense**.
 
• **Option 4** is in **passive voice.**
